_comment: 🕸️ The DAG parent owns no mutation (design §20.15): nodes and edges live in the composed content child (s.stdio.semio@v1/graph) and are edited only by that child's leaves, whose catalogs, vectors and independent Python implementation live with the stdio semio graph subset (`🪆️subsets/🕸️graph/🔮️oracles/🔣️.json`, `🧪️tests/🌳️mutate-semio-graph`).
